polycrisis_channels_converge.visual_brief: Separate crisis channels converge into one systemic pressure point.
polycrisis_channels_converge.subject: energy, trade and finance channels drawn as distinct pale routes converging into one red stress node

chokepoint_to_macro_shock.visual_brief: A maritime chokepoint becomes a transmission belt from energy risk to food, fiscal and financial stress.
chokepoint_to_macro_shock.subject: a narrow strait blocked by a red gate, with pale tanker routes turning into a grain field and a price line

maritime_rulemaking_gate.visual_brief: A chokepoint is no longer only blocked; it is turned into a parallel legal regime.
maritime_rulemaking_gate.subject: a narrow sea passage crossed by a red toll gate and a severe legal arch, with tanker silhouettes waiting outside

africa_policy_scaffold.visual_brief: A development partnership is being staged, but the load-bearing structure remains incomplete.
africa_policy_scaffold.subject: an African continent silhouette held by scaffolding, one red missing support, and a small diplomatic table below

institutional_coordination_table.visual_brief: A coordination table is present, but the agenda is unstable and one seat is misaligned.
institutional_coordination_table.subject: seven austere chairs around a round table, one displaced, with a red agenda disk at the centre

structural_adjustment_trial.visual_brief: Structural adjustment is put on trial, with evidence and counter-evidence weighing against each other.
structural_adjustment_trial.subject: a courtroom scale weighing a policy document against a data ledger, with one red unresolved verdict mark

shrinking_public_good.visual_brief: Public-goods demand expands while official financing narrows.
shrinking_public_good.subject: public goods represented by a bridge, clinic or seedling while coins shrink along a red descending path

debt_architecture_imbalance.visual_brief: The financial architecture still stands, but its columns carry unequal loads.
debt_architecture_imbalance.subject: a severe institutional facade with columns under asymmetric weight and a red stress line at the base

blocked_route_redirected_flow.visual_brief: A blocked official route creates shadow routes and redistributes costs.
blocked_route_redirected_flow.subject: a trade route stopped by a red barrier while pale bypass routes curve around ports and factories

sme_margin_squeeze.visual_brief: Small firms absorb geopolitical shocks in margins because prices and investment cannot adjust freely.
sme_margin_squeeze.subject: small factory blocks and margin bars squeezed by a red clamp, with input costs entering and investment blocked

fiscal_space_vs_security.visual_brief: Security spending rises faster than fiscal and industrial capacity.
fiscal_space_vs_security.subject: a scale weighing defence bars against factory capacity and a narrow budget column

fragility_last_lever.visual_brief: An external actor has one remaining lever in a fragile system.
fragility_last_lever.subject: a thin red lever beside a fractured map or institutional object, with the rest of the scene almost still

migration_cohesion_pressure.visual_brief: Migration pressure and political cohesion pull on the same European fabric.
migration_cohesion_pressure.subject: a taut fabric map of Europe held by two opposing forces, with one red tear beginning at the centre

infrastructure_corridor.visual_brief: A transport corridor becomes a geopolitical spine rather than a neutral infrastructure project.
infrastructure_corridor.subject: a rail corridor crossing a simplified African map, with ports, one red bottleneck and a pale trade route

transition_under_constraint.visual_brief: Energy transition options are balanced on a constrained geopolitical base.
transition_under_constraint.subject: a wind turbine, fuel pipe and grid line balanced on a small red fulcrum

imperial_overreach_myth.visual_brief: Imperial ambition is built as architecture, but the structure is already unstable.
imperial_overreach_myth.subject: a severe ziggurat or monumental tower cracking along a red fault line

sovereign_recours_symbol.visual_brief: A sovereign institution keeps one legal-religious lever in reserve.
sovereign_recours_symbol.subject: a severe institutional doorway, a small key and a red thread connecting it to a distant public square

macro_path_break.visual_brief: A smooth baseline path breaks into a fragmented macro trajectory.
macro_path_break.subject: a pale expected growth line interrupted by a red fracture and branching lower paths
